title: Al de Kinderliederen
summary: "Al de Kinderliederen" by J.P. Heije is a collection of children's songs published in 1861. This compilation contains 150 songs originally released in three separate volumes between 1843-1845. Breaking with tradition, Heije collaborated with prominent Dutch composers to create original melodies for his texts, moving away from moralizing themes toward celebrating childhood and nature.
